info.title: Pacific Feed Origin ICD
info.description: The closed contract for how an object may reach a person's feed. This is a product choice stated as schema: Pacific's feed has NO opaque algorithm, so the set of origins is closed, every feed object carries exactly one origin stamp, every stamp renders as a one-line 'why', and the refusals below are typed so that weakening any of them is a visible schema change reviewed like code — never a quiet product drift. Technical anchor: the stamp vocabulary canonicalises the provenance enum already shipped in coordination/feed-dataset.schema.json (member/system/hop) and adds the read-time 'derived' class ruled in docs/groups-events-ia.html (occurrences from event.setSchedule; market-face projections from postures). Conformance: pacific-core/src/feed_origin_icd.rs fails when this document and the code drift.

member.summary: Residue of an own fold: the object lives in a GroupObject the person is a member of. Self-authored objects are member-origin with hops absent (your own groups include your identity record).
member.authority: the MLS membership itself — presence in the roster is the read permission

hop.summary: Carried over connections: surfaced via a connection's membership or a place's log reached through discovery (contact ops 7/8). Bounded hops — distance is part of the stamp, never hidden.
hop.authority: the connection edge that carried it; each hop is an attributable relay

system.summary: Offered by a named System (kind 21): reference rows hydrated from registered feeds (ra.seoul, artrabbit.seoul, schoolcal). Always labelled with the system's name; always loses to minted objects on collision.
system.authority: the System's registration; a system without a name cannot author

derived.summary: Implied at read time by owned state — computed in the jewels' filter configs, NEVER stored (no derived truth stored as fact). A derivation cites the object and rule that imply it; deleting the source deletes the derivation with nothing to clean up.
derived.authority: the source object's own origin; a derivation cannot exceed its source's reach

occurrence.summary: Upcoming occurrences computed from an event spine's weekly schedule; an occurrence becomes an object only on first RSVP (F-B hydration, keyed spine_id+local_date).

market_projection.summary: Market-face rows projected from HOLDS/WANTS/OFFERS postures.

collision.summary: When two objects resolve as the same real thing (same_as / dedup key), one wins everywhere. Minted-wins, formalised: closeness to the person outranks reach.
collision.key: resolution identity (graph_resolution same_as / minted-wins dedup key)
collision.derived_excluded: a derivation never collides — it cites its source instead

ordering.summary: Feed order is a pure deterministic function of the stamps and the graph — reproducible from a person's own store, explainable line by line.
forbidden_inputs: any signal not derivable from the person's own store

refusals.name: paid-origin
refusals.statement: No origin can be bought. There is no ads class, no promoted class, no pay-to-place. Money never mints reach.

refusals.name: learned-ranking
refusals.statement: No learned ranker orders the feed. Ordering is the pure function above; removing this refusal is a schema change, not a tuning decision.

refusals.name: ai-authored
refusals.statement: No AI-authored objects reach the feed. Systems relay named external feeds; they do not generate. (User-facing No-AI stance, 10 Aug positioning.)

refusals.name: unstamped
refusals.statement: An object without a valid origin stamp does not render. There is no default origin.
